title: Rename sidecar input filtering
summary: Rename preview/apply now canonicalize staged input to media files while treating .pipeline.json and related sidecars as media companions.
reason: Folder-based Rename staging included sidecar JSON files as standalone TV rows, causing manual TV episode numbering to skip every other episode.
behavior_before: Folder-file staging could include .pipeline.json files. The planner assigned TV sequence numbers by raw row offset, so sidecars consumed episode numbers and appeared as preview rows.
behavior_after: Rename input is classified into media, sidecar, non-media, and duplicate buckets. Preview/apply plan only media rows, .pipeline.json/.mediapipeline.json sidecars are moved through sidecar_moves, and the WebView reports ignored sidecar/non-media counts.
tests_added: WebView rename smoke sidecar summary/no-sidecar-row assertions
